name: Phyllis Redrup
original_name: フィリス・レッドラップ
source: The younger daughter of the current king. Despite her status as a princess, she often gets in fights with the boys and is quite rude as well. Will, who happens to be her classmate, is no exception as well. Due to this, she is quite isolated from the other students yet is still one of the institute's most popular students.
